item.title: 'Ashita no Joe' Manga Artist Tetsuya Chiba Dies at 87
item.description: Tetsuya Chiba, best known as the artist for the Ashita no Joe (Ashita no Joe: Fighting for Tomorrow) manga, died on October 22. He was 87. Born in Tokyo in January 1939, Chiba made his professional debut with Fukushuu no Semushi in 1956.
